identity.name: Glass Reed Bow
identity.summary: A translucent jade bow reinforced by dark bamboo joints.
identity.description: Costs 2 stamina per activation. Deals 11 physical damage per affordable activation. Bypasses up to 3 enemy block per activation.
identity.lore: It sings like a wineglass when the string is drawn.

effects.description: Costs 2 stamina per activation. Deals 11 physical damage per affordable activation. Bypasses up to 3 enemy block per activation.

conditions: All ingredients are packed, unlocked, nonpermanent and form one orthogonally connected group.
recipes.failureBehavior: Incomplete, disconnected or locked inputs consume nothing. A complete recipe always consumes its inputs; an output that cannot fit enters the stash.
